content.short: Launchcaster is a place for discovering and launching new web3 projects.
content.description: Launchcaster helps you discover and launch new web3 projects. After you connect your wallet, you can browse ongoing launches, see details, and cast your vote on which projects move forward. When you're ready to submit a launch, simply reply to an existing Farcaster post or start a new one with "@launch". A dedicated launch bot will create the post and reply with a link to the submission, making it easy to track and share launches within the ecosystem.
